content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Describe the stages of the cardiac cycle
Explain how the heart generates and coordinates contractions
Interpret graphs showing pressure changes during the cardiac cycle
Describe how heart rate is controlled

is the sequence of events that occurs during one heartbeat. It involves the coordinated contraction and relaxation of heart chambers, controlled by electrical signals. Understanding the cardiac cycle explains how the heart pumps blood efficiently.
Takes about 0.8 seconds at rest (75 beats/min)
